Upgrow marketing operations platform

The internal web app I designed and built for the paid media team at work. One warehouse pulls the ad, tag, task, meeting and CRM data. Workflows on top handle monthly reports, search term reviews, budget pacing and meeting notes. Every client gets alerts and one timeline, and a portfolio view rates client health each week. It never changes an account on its own.
